description: Run the pre-send deliverability checks (suppression, domain health, content quality, deliverability score) without sending. Returns `valid`, a `confidence_score` (0–1), the per-check results in `checks` — including `from_domain_healthy.dkim_status` (`pass`, `fail` or `unknown`); `from_domain_healthy.spf` and `.dmarc` reflect whether the domain is verified with Truncus, not a live DNS check — non-blocking `warnings`, and a `recommendation` (`safe_to_send`, `send_with_caution` or `do_not_send`). Use before truncus_send to catch issues early when generating email content from an LLM.
name: truncus_validate
title: Validate an email payload (dry-run)
